ios.desc:
Denoise cleans up bad voice recordings. Instantly. On your iPhone or iPad. Completely private.

Tap one button. Background noise, fan hum, traffic, room echo, and wind are gone. Your voice stays clear.

No audio leaves your device. No subscription needed to denoise. No DAW jargon to learn.

NEW: VOICE RECORDER THAT CLEANS AS YOU RECORD
• Record right in Denoise: tap + and Recorder. Works with the built-in microphone and with wired, USB and Bluetooth mics.
• On iOS 18 and later, Denoise can remove the background noise while you record, so the clean recording is ready the moment you stop.
• Pause, resume or stop from the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island.
• A call pauses the recording instead of ending it. Every take is saved as you record, so nothing is lost if the app closes.

NEW: SHORTEN LONG RECORDINGS
• AI · Shorten trims long pauses and speeds up speech without changing the voice. A 73-minute lecture comes out at about 50 minutes.
• Choose how much with one slider. Short pauses stay, so it still sounds natural. Works on audio and video.

WHAT'S NEW IN 4.0
• AI Denoise (Free): on-device neural network, built for voices. Runs in seconds.
• Pro Rescue: restores impossible recordings - clipped audio, heavy reverb, low-quality phone calls, distant voice memos. Premium.
• Before/after toggle: hear the difference instantly.
• Faster export with iOS 17 and 18.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Podcasters cleaning up guest tracks recorded on iPhone
• Journalists rescuing field interviews
• Students saving lecture recordings from echoey halls
• Creators making TikTok, Reels, and Shorts that don't sound like they were recorded in a parking lot
• Anyone who hits Voice Memos and regrets it later

WHY DENOISE
• 100% on-device. We never see your audio.
• Works on what you already have: Voice Memos, Photos videos, Files, share sheet, and as a Photos extension.
• Pro power-user mode keeps the manual 5-band EQ and noise-floor slider for people who want it.
• Export to .m4a or .mp3, send anywhere.

Try Denoise on your worst recording. We bet it sounds usable.

DENOISE PRO

Denoise Pro is a premium subscription that unlocks unlimited saving and exporting of your cleaned recordings, plus Pro Rescue, our most powerful restoration for difficult audio. The core AI denoiser is always free - Denoise Pro keeps the app ad-free and funds its continued development. Denoise Pro is available as a monthly auto-renewable subscription or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple
